inNoComponent.why: this product's own page table, which the kit reads only through `trait Pages` (`zikaron_ui::nav`); each product writes its own.

this product's window start and its windowless drivers and probes over its own places; each product writes its own, opening the window at the kit's least size (`MIN_W` × `MIN_H`, which `ui-kit`'s test reads there) and handing the desktop channel its frame waker.
this product's own pages and sheets, declared by `window/mod.rs` and reached through its page table; each product writes its own.
this product's own tables, its seats and its compiled-in deployments; each product writes its own.
the core crate is this product's ledger law; only its `trace.rs` is in a component (`app-skeleton`), and each product writes its own crate root declaring it.
this product's own action handlers, reached only through the action layer's dispatch in `action/mod.rs`.

this product's own features (record packages, grants and their vault, retraction, mirrors, verification and its read-only networks, the first-run wizard and the rest), reached from the components' files only through wiring.
this product's own command-line modules, reached from the components' files only through the verb table and the product's entry, kit and ledger calls.
this product's own, declared only by their crate's root; the components do not depend on them.
this product's kit writer; `one-file`'s `container.rs` uses it only in its own tests, and the component does not depend on it.
this product's own record-kit crate, which the app depends on; each product writes its own.
this product's own registry and table, which `tools/family-reg` computes and the components' tests read; each product writes its own.
this product's own front page, licence summary and release tool, which the components' tests read where they are present; each product writes its own.
this product's own Model Context Protocol server for its command line, reached only through the verb table (`verbs::run` dispatches `mcp`); a product without it writes none.

ownTests.why: They pin this product's own ledger law (roots, entries, retraction, succession, cosigning, history and its hashes, the audit and its input, trie proofs, chain readings and deployments); each product writes its own.
They pin this product's own record kits, grants and payload codes (the kit law, bundles, grant chains and files, the vault); each product writes its own.
They pin this product's own ledger mirrors, adoption and backup bundles; each product writes its own.
They pin this product's own pages, first-run wizard and window walks; each product writes its own.
It pins how this product's own test runs are kept apart.
